text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives Italy's Prime Minister Romano Prodi on Thursday. Prodi is on a two-day visit to the Gulf Arab state to promote economic ties.

- Kuwait complains to the United Nations about Iraqi naval incident. The official Kuwait News Agency has said an Iraqi boat opened fire on a Kuwaiti coast guard patrol and a civilian vessel on April 12.

- Kuwait arrests four Iraqi infiltrators. Iraq-Kuwait border posts have been closed for normal traffic since the 1991 Gulf War, but Iraqis have regularly crossed to the Gulf Arab state to smuggle goods or seek asylum in third countries.
- Investment and real estate firms lead strong trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange, index rises 9.3 points to 2,297.3.
- Emir sends message to United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan.
- Kuwait to host meeting on cloning. The confernce will tackle cloning from a scientific angle only.
